title: Ingadi Eyanyamalala Ngobusuku Obodwa
intro: Cabanga ngensimu evundile, egcwele izithelo ezivuthiwe futhi izungezwe izihlahla ezinde. Labo ababeyinakekela babecabanga ukuthi bahlakaniphile, behlela isivuno sabo emahoreni athule ngaphambi kokusa, kude namehlo alabo abaswele. Kodwa Lowo ongalali wayenezinye izinhlelo zenzuzo yabo efihliwe. Ungaqagela ukuthi ubani omi ngemuva kwale ndaba yesixwayiso evela ku-Quran?
clues: Sake saba nensimu evundile futhi eningi kangangokuthi yaba nomona kubo bonke abadlulayo.
Ekuhleleni kwethu, sahlebelana ekuseni kakhulu, samemezela ukuthi akukho muntu oswele ozovunyelwa ukungena ngalolo suku.
Sasingabantu abacebile, futhi izinhliziyo zethu zase zingasaboni amalungelo abampofu abasizungezile.
Lapho kufika ukusa kokuvunwa esasikuhlosile, sasondela engadini yethu sayithola iguqulwe yaba yincithakalo emnyama ngobusuku obubodwa.
Isimemezelo esibhubhisayo sadlula, sashiya umlotha kuphela lapho kwakulenga khona amaqoqo ezithelo ezivuthiwe.
Indaba yethu iyisixwayiso esiqinile esilotshwe kuyiQuran, lapho saziwa khona njengabanikazi bensimu ababegodlela abaswele usizo.
